This proved to be very successful but the need for expansion was necessary. Upon the retirement of Mrs. Pansy Hamilton Brown, Iris Strachan, and Clevette Gibson took the reins and took EAP to the next level. The demands on the officers made me realize that the service needed to be made available to all government employees and the idea to expand the service was decided. * Ability to anticipate and identify problems and use sound judgment and fact-based analysis to develop effective and efficient solutions. 
* Software skills, including use of Microsoft Office software and web-based applications. 
* Ability to work day, evening and overnight hours as business needs dictate.
